intro: Luxembourg's culture mixes French and German influences with its own traditions.

chapters.title: Traditions
text: The Echternach dancing procession, in which pilgrims hop through the streets, is on UNESCO's heritage list. The Schueberfouer funfair has been held since 1340.

chapters.title: Food
text: The national dish is Judd mat Gaardebounen, smoked pork with broad beans. Moselle wines and sparkling crémant are local specialities.

keyTerms.meaning: People moving forward together as part of a ceremony.
